title: Get the audience hook
summary: Returns the audience hook of your app. The signing secret is never returned.
responseNote: kind is https, or binding when a platform admin set the hook up for you.

errors.when: The app has no audience hook.

title: Set the audience hook
summary: Sets or replaces the https endpoint Relay calls to fetch campaign recipients.

fields.name: url
fields.description: A public https URL, up to 2048 characters, without credentials.

fields.name: secret
fields.description: Your own signing secret, 16 to 256 characters. When omitted, Relay keeps the existing secret, or generates one for a new hook.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Set to false to switch the hook off.

responseNote: secret is returned only when Relay generated a new one. Otherwise it is null. Store it now: no endpoint returns it again.

errors.when: The body is not valid JSON or fails validation, including a non-public url.
The hook is a binding. A key cannot change it.
Relay cannot sign requests right now. Try again later.

title: Delete the audience hook
summary: Removes the audience hook of your app.

errors.when: The hook is a binding. A key cannot remove it.
The app has no audience hook.
